items.item: Recommends a before-save record-triggered flow (or formula field) and says why it beats after-save or Apex
items.evidence: "a before-save flow is the right tool. It needs no extra DML and no second save." and "An after-save flow would re-run the whole save order on the same record. Apex would add code and tests for no gain."

items.item: Notes that a before-save flow cannot create or update other records
items.evidence: "Before-save flows can't touch other records. That doesn't matter here, because nothing else is written."
